item.title: Island Paradise of Mauritius Has Sun, Beaches and Too Many Dogs
item.description: Mauritius, a popular tourist destination off southern Africa, has become overrun with strays. With more and more residents chased and attacked, many are fed up.

item.title: Doug Ford Says He’d Use a Gun to Protect His Family
